title: Generation of Aligned Functional Myocardial Tissue Through Microcontact Printing
protocol: Mix Sylgard 184 PDMS elastomer at a 10:1 base to curing agent ratio.
Degas the mixture using a desiccator to eliminate any air bubbles.
Cure PDMS against a previously fabricated master with specified dimensions for either 2 days at room temperature or 4 hours at 65°C.
Clean stamps with 70% Ethanol to remove dust and dirt particles.
Let stamps air dry.
Place stamps in an SPI Plasma-Prep II Plasma Cleaner and process for 1 minute at 275 mTorr.
Sterilize stamps with 70% Ethanol for 1 minute.
Dry sterilized stamps quickly with compressed air.
Prepare Mouse Embryonic Fibroblast (MEF)-Medium: Mix Dulbecco's Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM), 10% Fetal Bovine Serum (FBS) ES cell-grade, and 1% Penicillin-Streptomycin (P/S).

Prepare Embryonic Stem Cell (ESC)-Medium: Combine DMEM, 15% FBS ES cell-grade, 1% Non-Essential Amino Acids (NEAA), 0.5% P/S, 0.2% Leukemia Inhibitory Factor (LIF), and 0.0007% 2-Mercaptoethanol (2-ME).
Coat 6-well plates with sterile 0.1% Gelatin in ddH2O and let it adsorb for 15 min at 37°C.
Add MEFs from a thawed aliquot to 50 ml PBS, centrifuge them at 1,000 rpm for 5 min, and resuspend in MEF-medium.
After gelatin adsorption, aspirate excess Gelatin and add MEFs into the wells.
Allow MEFs 1 day to attach.
When MEFs have attached, add ES cells from a thawed aliquot to 50 ml PBS in a conical tube and centrifuge them at 1,000 rpm for 5 min.
Resuspend ES cells in ESC-medium and add them to the wells containing MEFs.
Culture ES cells in ESC-medium until confluence is reached.
Aspirate ESC-medium when ES cells have reached confluence.
Wash once with sterile PBS.
Add 500 μl of Trypsin after aspirating PBS.
Process 3.5 min at 37 °C.
Pipette the Trypsin solution up and down several times to break down ES cell colonies.
Neutralize Trypsin with 500 μl of ESC-medium.
Passage ES cells according to your desired ratio, e.g., transfer 33 μl to another well with previously prepared MEFs for a passage 1/30.
Maintain ES cells in ESC-Medium.
Start in vitro differentiation when ES cells have reached confluence.
Coat 10 cm culture dishes with sterile 0.1% Gelatin in ddH2O.
Let Gelatin adsorb for 15 minutes at 37 °C.
Harvest ES cells as before.
Aspirate excess Gelatin and add approximately 1/3-1/2 of the ES cell suspension to prepared culture dishes containing Adaptation-medium.
Culture cells for 2 days.
Harvest adapted ES cells into a 50 ml conical tube containing PBS using 1.5 ml of Trypsin.
Centrifuge dissociated ES cells at 1,000 rpm for 5 minutes.
Resuspend them in Differentiation-medium.
Make embryoid bodies (EBs) of approximately 1,000 cells per 10 μl drop in 15 cm culture dishes using a multi-channel pipette.
Invert the plates and culture EBs as hanging droplets for 2.5 days at 37 °C.
Pool EBs of 6-8 15 cm culture dishes into one using Differentiation-medium after 2.5 days.
Culture pooled EBs for an additional 3.5 days at 37 °C.
Collect EBs in a conical 50 ml tube after 3.5 days.
Let the EBs sink to the bottom for approximately 5 minutes.
Suck up the supernatant and wash EBs with sterile PBS.
Let EBs sink again to the bottom for approximately 5 minutes.
Dissociate EBs by processing them with 2.5 ml of Trypsin for 2 min in a water bath at 37 °C, shaking the tube softly.
Add 2.5 ml of sterile PBS to the Trypsin solution and pipette up and down with a 10 ml serological pipette approximately 8-10 times to break down cell clusters.
Neutralize Trypsin with 10 ml of FACS buffer containing 7.5% FBS ES cell- or Differentiation-grade and 0.01% DAPI in PBS.
Centrifuge dissociated EBs at 1,000 rpm for 5 min.
Resuspend them in approximately 1 ml of FACS buffer.
Pipette up and down with a 1 ml pipette approximately 8-10 times to break down cell clusters.
Transfer cells to a sterile round-bottom tube with a 35 μm cell strainer to obtain a single cell suspension.
Sort differentiated ES cells using a FACSAria Flow Cytometer and obtain purified populations of CVP.
Gate on Forward Scatter Amplitude (FSC-A) and Side Scatter Amplitude (SSC-A).
Gate on FSC-A and Forward Scatter-Width (FSC-W).
Gate on SSC-A and Side Scatter-Width (SSC-W).
Gate on DAPI staining to isolate viable cells from non-viable cells.
Gate on Phycoerythrin Amplitude (PE-A) and PE-Cyanine dye 7 Amplitude (PE-Cy7-A) to obtain true red-positive (R+) and true red-negative (R-) cells.
Sort true green-positive (G+) and true green-negative (G-) cells within R+ and R- populations separately on Fluorescein isothiocyanate Amplitude (FITC-A) and PE-A.
Passivate micropatterned substrates with 1% Pluronic F-127 in ddH2O for 10 min.
Wash the substrates 3 times with sterile PBS.
Attach PDMS gaskets around the patterned region and press firmly.
Seed CVP onto Fibronectin micropatterned substrates.
